SessionStart.command: set "A=$(node "./dist/gate.mjs" session-start --from-plugin; printf 'x%s' "$?")$(exit 0)"; out=${1#A=}; s=${out##*x}; ok=${s%%[1-9]*}; printf '%s' "${ok:+${out%x*}}"; exit 0

hooks.command: set "A=$(node "./dist/gate.mjs" claude-hook --from-plugin; printf 'x%s' "$?")$(exit 0)"; out=${1#A=}; s=${out##*x}; ok=${s%%[1-9]*}; printf '%s' "${ok:+${out%x*}}"; exit 0
